bio: Hi, I'm Elena, a 22-year-old who moved from Santa Cruz to Monterey two years ago for the coastal life. I work as an Environmental Educator at the Monterey Bay Aquarium, creating programs that teach visitors about marine conservation while staying organized and detail-focused behind the scenes. My close-knit family, including my parents and younger brother, gave me a steady foundation that keeps me grounded and open to new experiences. Outside work, I kayak in the bay, hike Big Sur, photograph tide pools, and cook simple meals from local farmers' markets. I value quiet reflection through occasional church visits and meditation, and I'm single, hoping to meet someone kind for shared adventures and honest talks about life and travel.
